product_overview: Foco no ENEM is a free Brazilian educational platform that helps students prepare for the ENEM using AI-powered essay correction, AI-generated quizzes, curated news, a community forum, and gamified progress tracking. The platform integrates Supabase for auth/storage, Groq for LLM tasks, and Stripe for donations.
core_goals: Provide accurate, rubric-aligned AI grading for ENEM-style essays with actionable feedback across the five ENEM competencies.
Generate high-quality, discipline-specific multiple-choice quizzes and track user performance over time.
Offer a moderated news feed and community forum to keep students informed and motivated.
Support user accounts with performance dashboards, achievements, and privacy-compliant data handling.
Enable sustainable funding via Stripe donations and provide admin maintenance tools for reliability.

features.name: Homepage
features.description: Public landing page with hero, feature overview, and navigation to all app sections.
user_flows: GET / -> Receive 200 with homepage HTML and links to app sections
GET / -> Receive 500 when environment variables are missing (server-side config error)

features.name: Authentication
features.description: Email/password and OAuth registration, login, password recovery, and session management via Supabase Auth.
user_flows: POST /supabase/auth/v1/signup with email and password -> Receive 200 with user record and session token -> GET /api/conta/dados with token -> Receive 200 account data
POST /supabase/auth/v1/token (signIn) with email and password -> Receive 200 with session token -> GET / (protected route) with token -> Receive 200
POST /supabase/auth/v1/recover with email -> Receive 200 recovery email queued
POST /supabase/auth/v1/signup with an already-registered email -> Receive 400 email already registered
POST /supabase/auth/v1/token with wrong password -> Receive 401 invalid credentials
POST /supabase/auth/v1/reset (password reset submit) with invalid/expired code -> Receive 400 invalid or expired reset token

features.name: Essay Submission & Correction
features.description: Students request AI-generated themes, submit essays, and receive rubric-based corrections and detailed feedback (ENEM 5 competencies).
user_flows: GET /api/gerar-tema -> Receive 200 with generated essay theme and support texts
POST /api/corrigir with auth token and essay text (50-5000 chars) -> Receive 200 with correction ID and preliminary scores
GET /api/corrigir?id={correctionId} with auth token -> Receive 200 with full correction details, competency breakdown, and comments
POST /api/corrigir with essay text under 50 chars -> Receive 400 validation error (too short)
POST /api/corrigir after 5 requests/min from same user -> Receive 429 rate limit exceeded

features.name: Essay Results
features.description: Authenticated view of detailed essay correction results and historical access to saved corrections.
user_flows: GET /api/resultados/{id} with auth token -> Receive 200 with essay correction, per-competency scores, and feedback
GET /api/resultados/{id} with auth token for an ID owned by another user -> Receive 403 forbidden
GET /api/resultados/{invalidId} with auth token -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: Quiz Questions
features.description: AI-generated multiple-choice quizzes by discipline with explanations and optional persistence of results to user stats.
user_flows: GET /api/questoes?disciplina=Matematica -> Receive 200 with 3 multiple-choice questions and answer options
POST /api/questoes with answers payload (and optional user token) -> Receive 200 with scored results, answer explanations, and updated user stats if authenticated
POST /api/questoes with malformed payload -> Receive 400 validation error
GET /api/questoes without disciplina parameter -> Receive 400 missing disciplina parameter

features.name: User Account
features.description: User profile management, performance dashboard with charts, statistics recalculation, and account editing.
user_flows: GET /api/conta/dados with auth token -> Receive 200 with profile, streaks, achievements, and performance stats
POST /api/conta/recalcular with auth token -> Receive 200 with recalculated statistics
GET /api/conta/dados with expired token -> Receive 401 unauthorized
POST /api/conta/recalcular when database update fails -> Receive 500 internal server error

features.name: Community Forum
features.description: Topics, posts, threaded comments, likes, and real-time updates (SSE) for user discussions and knowledge sharing.
user_flows: POST /api/comunidade/posts with auth token and post content -> Receive 201 created with postId
GET /api/comunidade/threads?topic={topicId} -> Receive 200 with posts and threaded comments for the topic
POST /api/comunidade/comments with auth token and {postId, content} -> Receive 201 created comment
POST /api/comunidade/likes with {postIds:[...] } -> Receive 200 with likes counts for each post
GET /api/realtime-proxy -> Establish SSE connection and receive real-time events for new posts/comments/likes
POST /api/comunidade/posts with auth token and empty content -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/comunidade/comments on non-existent post -> Receive 404 post not found
GET /api/realtime-proxy when proxy SSE fails -> Receive 500 SSE proxy error

features.name: Achievements System
features.description: Gamified achievements unlocking based on user activity and milestones, triggered and checked via API.
user_flows: POST /api/conquistas with auth token and user stats -> Receive 200 with list of newly unlocked achievements and updated user record
POST /api/conquistas with auth token for user with no qualifying activity -> Receive 200 with empty unlocked list
POST /api/conquistas without auth token -> Receive 401 unauthorized
POST /api/conquistas with malformed stats payload -> Receive 400 validation error

features.name: News Section
features.description: Curated ENEM-related news, search and filtering, individual article pages, and admin import/moderation tools.
user_flows: GET /api/noticias?page=1&tag=ENEM -> Receive 200 with paginated list of news articles and metadata
GET /api/noticias/busca?q=enem+temas -> Receive 200 with search results matching query
POST /api/noticias/importar with admin auth token and source config -> Receive 201 with count of imported articles
GET /api/noticias/busca with empty q parameter -> Receive 400 missing search keyword
POST /api/noticias/importar with non-admin token -> Receive 403 forbidden

features.name: Donation (Stripe)
features.description: Stripe-powered donation checkout with preset and custom amounts, plus webhook processing for payment events.
user_flows: POST /api/doacao/checkout with amount and optional metadata -> Receive 200 with Stripe checkoutSessionId
POST /api/doacao/webhook with Stripe event and valid signature -> Receive 200 event processed (payment_intent.succeeded triggers donation record)
POST /api/doacao/checkout with amount below R$5 -> Receive 400 validation error
POST /api/doacao/webhook with invalid signature -> Receive 400 invalid signature

features.name: Admin Maintenance
features.description: Admin-only endpoints for cache cleanup, analytics maintenance, and AI-driven update of featured news.
user_flows: POST /api/admin/manutencao with admin auth token -> Receive 200 maintenance completed and cleaned caches
GET /api/atualizarDestaques with admin auth token -> Receive 200 featured news updated using AI selection
POST /api/admin/manutencao without admin token -> Receive 403 forbidden
GET /api/atualizarDestaques when AI service fails -> Receive 500 external AI service error

features.name: Static Pages
features.description: About, Privacy Policy, and Terms of Service pages served as static routes.
user_flows: GET /sobre -> Receive 200 with About page HTML
GET /privacidade -> Receive 200 with Privacy Policy HTML
GET /termos -> Receive 200 with Terms of Service HTML
GET /sobre when environment variables are missing -> Receive 500 server-side rendering error
